criteria.text: Given PrototypeFixtures (JD keywords have SQL, Power BI, Excel, Python, Forecasting; missing Stakeholder mgmt, Financial reporting, Variance analysis), When KeywordCoverage computes now, upTo and final with the quick answer YES plus detail and again without the answer, Then each value equals the formula's rounded percent asserted literally in the test (now = 5 of 8 distinct keywords -> 63 with half-up rounding), now <= upTo, and final with the answer > final without it; 61 -> 92 and 84 are not reachable with 8 keywords, so the PR lists the computed values (D5).

Given requirements whose keywords repeat with different case (SQL in two requirements, 'sql' in a third), When the distinct set is built, Then it counts once; Given no keywords, Then every percent is 0 and nothing divides by zero.

Given matches with statuses MET, PARTIAL and GAP and a quick answer, When upTo is computed, Then it counts keywords of MET and PARTIAL requirements plus keywordsStatedIn(answered requirement, requirement text + detail) for choice YES or FEW, and adds nothing for NOT_YET or SKIPPED.

Given a tailored resume with ACCEPTED, REJECTED and unchanged changes, When final is computed, Then it counts keywords present in the accepted text only (a REJECTED change contributes its original text).

Given the prototype JD and profile, When ScreenForKeywords runs, Then it returns have = [SQL, Power BI, Excel, Python, Forecasting], missing = [Stakeholder mgmt, Financial reporting, Variance analysis] and count 8 (order as in the requirements).

Given PrototypeFixtures fresh (one open required gap, no LinkedIn), fixed (no gap, no LinkedIn) and fixed with LinkedIn, When ProfileCompleteness runs, Then it returns 90, 96 and 100; with many gaps the value never goes below 0.

Given profile entries, When RequiredGaps runs, Then an EXPERIENCE entry with a start date, a blank end date and no open-ended end word is a gap carrying its entry id and title (the screen formats 'End date missing for <title>' from resources); a current entry (end date 'Present' or another FactDateFormat open-ended word), a non-EXPERIENCE entry and an entry with an end date are not gaps; fresh fixtures yield exactly one gap for Data Analyst Intern.

Given ObserveStartDestinationUseCase, When the account is null, Then it emits SignIn; When signed in with no profile.reviewedAt and onboarding not complete, Then Upload; When signed in and reviewedAt is set, or the legacy onboardingComplete flag is true (existing installs), Then Applications; the six existing ObserveStartDestinationUseCaseTest assertions still pass (only the constructor call changes).

issues.title: feat(domain): quick-answer facts, summary and skills in the fabrication guard, and one Accept changes decision

criteria.text: Given a quick answer YES or FEW with detail for requirement R, When the guard checks a bullet that cites ans-<R> and whose words, numbers and terms all come from R's text or the detail, Then it passes; When the bullet adds a term, number or scale claim found in neither, Then the guard reports UnsupportedTerm, UnsupportedNumber or UnsupportedScaleClaim and the original text (or no bullet) is used.
Given a quick answer NOT_YET or SKIPPED, When tailoring runs, Then no USER_ANSWER fact exists and any bullet citing ans-<R> fails with MissingSource.

Given the prototype answer detail 'presented the monthly variance report to the CFO' (names no employer), When tailoring proposes an answer-backed bullet under the Infosys entry, Then it is not attached to Infosys and the answer may support only the summary or the skills line (Changes count 3, R3); Given a detail that names 'Infosys' (or the entry title 'Business Analyst'), Then the bullet may attach to that entry (whole-word, case-insensitive).

Given a tailored summary, When the guard runs, Then every sentence must cite source ids of confirmed facts (profile or USER_ANSWER) and pass the same checks as a bullet; a sentence with no source or a violation falls back to the original summary, so no unsupported sentence reaches the result.

Given a tailored skills line, When the guard runs, Then reordered skills come only from the confirmed profile, and added skills only from user-stated skills or answer-grounded keywords; any other added skill is removed or flagged with a violation.
Given new suggestions, When they are created, Then each starts PENDING (I.2); When Undo is applied to a change, Then UpdateBulletDecisionUseCase sets it to REJECTED and the original text is used.

Given an application with PENDING, ACCEPTED and REJECTED changes, When AcceptChangesUseCase runs, Then every PENDING becomes ACCEPTED, REJECTED stays REJECTED, and changesAcceptedAt is set from the injected Clock; running it again changes nothing else.

Given an application whose changesAcceptedAt is null, When export is requested through the domain export check, Then it is refused; Given changesAcceptedAt is set but a change is PENDING again (for example after a re-tailor), Then it is refused; Given every change is decided and changesAcceptedAt is set, Then it is allowed.
Given the pack list, When it is read, Then it holds exactly application_pack_5 (5 credits), application_pack_15 (15) and application_pack_40 (40), each with creditsExpire false.

Given a successful tailoring for application A, When the credit spend is mapped, Then exactly one credit is spent (one ledger entry, kind TAILORING, amount -1, applicationId A); Given a failed or interrupted tailoring, Then no credit is spent.

Given the I.1 and I.2 gate tests, When ./gradlew :core:domain:testDebugUnitTest --tests '*OfflineFabricationGuardTest' --tests '*TailorResumeUseCaseTest' --tests '*UpdateBulletDecisionUseCaseTest' and :feature:tailor:impl:testDebugUnitTest --tests '*TailorViewModelTest' run, Then all existing cases pass unchanged and the new USER_ANSWER, summary and skills cases pass.
Given the branch head, When ./gradlew :core:domain:koverVerify runs, Then it passes (>= 80%).
Given the branch head, When tools/ci/verify-local.sh runs, Then it passes.
